The image shows a stem infection at the soil line with white fungal mycelium visible on a brown, discolored stem. Key features: white cottony growth on stem base, stem girdling near soil.

This is a **stem** infection. Top candidates from part index: Southern_Blight, Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot, Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, Gray_Mold, Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers.

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with the top candidates.

**View 1: Southern_Blight (stem)**

This shows a stem canker with brown/bleached areas but not the prominent white mycelium at the soil line like in the test image.

**View 2: Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot (stem)**

Sclerotinia shows dense white cottony mycelium with grayish-black sclerotia. The mycelium is very extensive. The test image has more localized white growth.

**View 3: Southern_Bacterial_Wilt (stem)**

Southern Bacterial Wilt shows internal vascular browning in a cut stem. Not matching the external white mycelium in the test image.

**View 4: Gray_Mold (stem)**

This is a microscopic view of Gray Mold spores, not comparable to the field-level test image.

**View 5: Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers (stem)**

Another microscopic view. Let me continue with field-level images.

**View 6: Bacterial_Wilt (stem)**

Bacterial Wilt shows bacterial streaming from a cut stem in water. Not matching.

**View 7: Rhizopus_Soft_Rots (stem)**

Rhizopus shows dense whitish-gray fuzzy mycelia covering the entire stem. The test image has more localized white patches.

**View 8: Southern_Blight (stem - second reference)**

This Southern Blight reference is a strong match. It shows white mycelial growth at the stem base/crown near the soil line with brown stem discoloration, very similar to the test image.

## Analysis Summary

Comparing the test image across all viewed references:

| Class | Match Quality | Key Difference |
|-------|--------------|----------------|
| **Southern_Blight** | **Strong** | White mycelium at stem base/soil line, brown stem - matches test image |
| Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot | Moderate | Mycelium much more extensive/cottony with prominent dark sclerotia |
| Rhizopus_Soft_Rots | Weak | Dense uniform fuzzy coverage of entire stem |
| Southern_Bacterial_Wilt | No match | Internal vascular browning, no external mycelium |
| Bacterial_Wilt | No match | Bacterial streaming, no fungal growth |
| Gray_Mold | No match | Microscopic reference, gray-brown spores |
| Alternaria_Black_Molds | No match | Microscopic reference, dark concentric ring cankers |

The test image shows localized white fungal mycelium on a brown, discolored stem at the soil line, which is the classic presentation of Southern Blight (*Sclerotium rolfsii*). The Southern_Blight reference (Bugwood_48) closely matches this pattern.
